name: Interpolation Degree of the Interpolation/Effective-VC-Radius Counterexample
proof: On $000,011,101,110$, the four evaluation vectors of $1,x_1,x_2,x_3$ are linearly independent, so affine polynomials interpolate every function. Degree zero gives only constants. Hence $\mathrm{intdeg}=1$, as checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
